title: Serial dilution
note: 1 to 2 steps across six cups, food colouring

steps.say: Put 10 ml of water in cups 2 to 6
Put 20 ml of blue water in cup 1
Move 10 ml from cup 1 to cup 2
Move 10 ml from cup 2 to cup 3
Move 10 ml from cup 3 to cup 4
Move 10 ml from cup 4 to cup 5
Move 10 ml from cup 5 to cup 6

steps.question: Looking down at the six cups from left to right: does each cup look lighter blue than the one before it, from dark blue to very pale?
